summary: Build an explicit integral hyperbolic basis E of latMiddleGram(𝔰, N) (from an element of norm −1 and the reindexing of κ ∖ {k₀}), take θ the image of the flat chart measure under the Eichler orbit map and μH the normalised Haar measure of the integral points of 𝖧 (inverted), and verify the level axioms and the lattice-level properties.

steps.claim: Take c ∈ R with norm −1 (an element with cc̄ = −1 relation), the unimodularity of latMiddleGram(𝔰, N), and a bijection SplitIndex(m, ι) ≃ κ ∖ {k₀} (k = |ι| + 2m + 1).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨c, hc, e⟩, u, f⟩ := P.isAdelic.exists_norm_neg_one, isUnimodular_latMiddleGram 𝔰 hN,
    (equivOfCardEq (by simp +arith [hm]) : SplitIndex m ι ≃ {i // 𝔰.k₀ ≠ i})

steps.claim: E = the explicit basis matrix (hyperbolic pairs built from v, z with the trace element τ and c, the identity elsewhere).
steps.lean:
let E := inclMatrix A (![inl 𝔰.k₀, inr ()] ⊕ᵥ (inl <| f ·)) * @fromBlocks _ (SplitIndex m ι) _
    (SplitIndex m ι) A !![-1, -N * P.τ; 0, 1] 0 0 (fromBlocks 1 (fromCols 0 (P.τ • 1))
    (fromRows 0 (c • 1)) (fromBlocks 1 0 0 ((-star P.τ * c) • 1)))

steps.claim: E is integral.
steps.lean: have hE : IsIntMatrix R E := .mul (by simp) (by simp [*])

steps.claim: E is a hyperbolic basis of latMiddleGram(𝔰, N):

    rw [gram_mul, gram_inclMatrix]
    simp [entrywise, latMiddleGram, diagonal, (f _).2.symm, Subtype.val_inj]

steps.claim: entrywise,
steps.lean: simp [entrywise, latMiddleGram, diagonal, (f _).2.symm, Subtype.val_inj]

steps.claim: J = the whole Gram matrix; φ(p) = the floor basis at top applied to the flat chart of the hyperbolic Gram matrix at p.
steps.lean:
let J := (latMiddleGram 𝔰 N).splitGram; let φ p :=

steps.claim: φ(p)_z = p₁₁, x̄J = the coordinate form at l and x_l = 0 (computation).
steps.lean:
